# has recurrence rule

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:hasRecurrenceRule`](gmeow-hasRecurrenceRule.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/hasRecurrenceRule>

Relates an event series to the recurrence rule by which it repeats.

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:EventSeries`](../classes/gmeow-EventSeries.md) -> [`gmeow:RecurrenceRule`](../classes/gmeow-RecurrenceRule.md)

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to attach a [`gmeow:RecurrenceRule`](../classes/gmeow-RecurrenceRule.md) to the [`gmeow:EventSeries`](../classes/gmeow-EventSeries.md) it governs.

### Avoid when

- Avoid attaching it to a single occurrence (the rule scopes the series, not one event).

### How to use

- Point the [`gmeow:EventSeries`](../classes/gmeow-EventSeries.md) at a [`gmeow:RecurrenceRule`](../classes/gmeow-RecurrenceRule.md) via [`gmeow:hasRecurrenceRule`](gmeow-hasRecurrenceRule.md); the rule carries its RRULE string on [`gmeow:recurrenceRuleText`](gmeow-recurrenceRuleText.md).

### Examples

- ex:standup [`gmeow:hasRecurrenceRule`](gmeow-hasRecurrenceRule.md) ex:weeklyMon.
